problems.sol:
DC steady state: a capacitor carries no current (open circuit) and an inductor has no voltage (short circuit).

The open capacitor kills the \(C\)–\(R_2\) branch. The shorted \(L\) ties the left of \(V_s\) to the bottom wire. What is left: \(V_s\) and \(R_1\) feeding the top of \(R_3\), plus \(I_s\) pushing into the same node.

Superposition. \(V_s\) alone (\(I_s\) open): divider, \(V_o=\frac{R_3}{R_1+R_3}V_s\). \(I_s\) alone (\(V_s\) shorted): \(I_s\) sees \(R_1\parallel R_3\), \(V_o=\frac{R_1R_3}{R_1+R_3}I_s\). That is option G.

To find an equivalent capacitance, turn off independent sources: the 1 V source becomes a short.

Capacitors combine opposite to resistors: parallel ones add, series ones combine as \(\frac{C_1C_2}{C_1+C_2}\).
